control_plane.name: Silver Mediums Agent Control Plane
control_plane.about_intro: Multica is the product underneath. The control plane is the Silver Mediums layer that decides how agents are allowed to work on it.

truthful_states.title: Honest status
truthful_states.body: A status says what has actually happened. Nothing is marked done because it was expected to be.

routing.title: Controlled routing
routing.body: Work moves between agents on set routes, and every handoff is recorded.

shared_knowledge.title: Shared instructions
shared_knowledge.body: Agents load the same saved skills and instructions for a job, so it is done the same way each time.

bounded_permissions.title: Bounded permissions
bounded_permissions.body: An agent gets only the access its task needs, and only while that task runs.

independent_review.title: Independent review
independent_review.body: A separate reviewer checks finished work before it counts as done.

release_verification.title: Release and runtime checks
release_verification.body: A release is matched to the reviewed build and confirmed healthy after it starts.

recovery.title: Recovery and rollback
recovery.body: Backups are restored and rehearsed in advance, so a bad change can be undone.

owner_inbox.title: Your Inbox
owner_inbox.body: Decisions that are yours arrive with the choice and its consequences spelled out.

usage.title: Usage awareness
usage.body: Runs, tokens, time and cost are recorded so you can see what the work consumed.
